text:
Maria Chen: Quick idea — can we add a `deploy pin --eta` flag to the deploy-bot so PMs can lock a release window with an ETA note? Right now people paste release notes + calendar links in multiple places.

Devin Patel: 👍 I hit this yesterday. Would be nice to auto-populate change-window + calendar invite.

Kai Nguyen: +1. Also, can the bot emit a short release checksum and a one-line rollback command? e.g., `rollback --from=375a9` so on-call can copy/paste.

Maria Chen: Prototype sketch: add `/deploy schedule --window \"2026-03-22 09:00-10:00\" --pin v1.3.2 --eta \"DB migration 10m\"`. Bot replies with a code block containing the calendar link + minimal release note template.

deploy-bot: [bot] Created tentative window. Generated event: https://cal.redwood.com/event/abc123. Release stub:
```
- version: v1.3.2
- owner: @maria
- eta: DB migration ~10m
- rollback: `rollback --from=v1.3.2`
```

Sara Lopez: Could we also have a `--dry-run` that prints the steps and the exact commands the CI will run? Saves the back-and-forth before scheduling.

Devin Patel: +1 to dry-run. For rollbacks: if we include `--canary=20%` in the schedule, bot should attach `--unwind` steps and a quick metric-check snippet.

Kai Nguyen: Implementation notes: add action in release service to generate the two artifacts: `release.json` and `instructions.md`. Bot should store them as a pinned Gist or in S3 and return links.

Maria Chen: UX: keep messages compact. Example bot output suggestion:
```
Release pinned: v1.3.2
Calendar: <link>
One-liner: quick summary here
Rollback cmd: `redwoodctl rollback --id=v1.3.2`
Dry-run: `--dry-run` shows steps
```

ops-bot: FYI, change-window policy: auto-approve for windows <30m, otherwise require @oncall signoff. Will enforce if feature enabled.

Sara Lopez: Could we also add a template generator: `deploy-bot template create --type=hotfix` that returns a filled checklist.

Devin Patel: I'll sketch an RFC and a small CLI shim for the bot. I can aim for a PR by EOD Wednesday. Anyone want to pair on the bot message formatting?

Kai Nguyen: I can help with the release service endpoints. Let's sync tomorrow 10am. @Maria Chen can you drop a sample calendar link we can use in tests?

Maria Chen: Yep — I'll paste a test event in #eng-releases later today. Thanks all :rocket:
